```{python}
import pandas as pd
from hazelnut.forecast.dataset import SHOCK_PERIODS
from hazelnut.site import charts
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops

prices = pd.read_csv(SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "prices_monthly.csv")
```
